notes: mailto: URI with percent-encoded subject and body. A mailto: URI is an address URI, not a web URL, so expected_urls is empty (consistent with Dataset 1). QR version 8, error correction M (~15%), module size 10px, quiet zone 4 modules, image 570x570px (8-bit greyscale PNG, black on white); payload length 126 characters; regenerated with QR mask pattern 0 because the default pattern was not decodable by every validator. Single QR code, no logo overlay, no obfuscation, no redirect services. All names, domains and numbers are fictional.
